metric: Equal2asset3h QLIKE primary-minus-comparator lower better; known=raw-logEWMA22. Normalized=y/v-log(y/v)-1 on positive targets, no percent of negative raw QLIKE.

22.method: Frozen synchronized noncircular moving origin-date blocks; same draw both assets and all3h

44.method: Frozen synchronized noncircular moving origin-date blocks; same draw both assets and all3h

frozen_criteria_verbatim.directional_confirmation: ensemble difference < 0 and at least two of three paired seed differences < 0
frozen_criteria_verbatim.secondary: report all asset/horizon directions, normalized QLIKE, MSE, every fixed comparator and ablation
frozen_criteria_verbatim.uncertainty: 2000 synchronized noncircular moving-block draws; blocks22/44; report95percent intervals
frozen_criteria_verbatim.claims: CI crossing zero allows only a point-improvement claim; no significance or true A/M/IV identification
frozen_criteria_verbatim.mechanism: M has no established development contribution; joint-clock differences do not establish it
frozen_criteria_verbatim.no_rescue: do not replace primary/metric/seed/epoch/asset/horizon using2026; MSE cannot rescue primary failure
frozen_criteria_verbatim.value: judge magnitude and strongest nonoperator comparator separately from numerical direction; no publication guarantee

decision.allowed_claim: small directional point improvement only, not significance
decision.overall_competitive_model_goal: NOT ACHIEVED on primary QLIKE, separate from directional criterion

N_evidence_limit: No test operator arrays or independent weight replay. alpha_N=0 inference bound to frozen development metadata+same checkpoint bytes+runner parameter-preservation assertions.

execution_record.HAR_HGB: original B.direct_baselines; pre2025 tr only, F16; one merged va+te predict per horizon; old2025 gate mandatory
